findings.summary: run/mod.rs is a listed deliverable but the plan does not edit it.
findings.evidence: The deliverables list crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs as 'modify', but decision 3 says run/mod.rs is not edited. The plan's Files list leaves it out. run/mod.rs:688 is the timed-out path (state set to TimedOut at :689), so leaving it alone is correct. Fix: Say in the change description that run/mod.rs was deliberately left unchanged, so the verifier does not count a missing deliverable against the job.

findings.summary: The 401 lead-in text is assumed, not taken from a real sample.
findings.evidence: No fixture under crates/ contains 'API Error'. The 'Failed to authenticate. API Error: 401' lead-in and the subtype success with is_error true come from the brief, not from a recorded sample. output_from_result (claude.rs:257-281) shows that this shape gives the detail 'success: <text>', so the parser path is right. Only the CLI text itself is assumed. Fix: In the producer step, Grep the state or records for a real 'the producer did not complete' outcome reason before fixing the accepted lead-ins, and quote it in a test comment if one is found.

findings.summary: Say in a doc comment why the read-time forecast matches the write-time one.
findings.evidence: try_watch_line at scope_guard.rs:771-772 now reads the forecast of line.last(). The new rule (the newest request with a finished attempt) is the same at write time only if the just-closed job is in the Records loaded at head. A request that joins the line while another job is running could make them differ. Fix: Add a short doc comment on line_forecast_p90 saying why it agrees with the write-time value, and keep t3_pause_from_reading_forecast as the guard.

summary: I read the code each step depends on, and it is there. scope_guard.rs has ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX (:53) and attempt_of (:525), which checks the prefix itself. disk.rs has is_environment_reason (:260) and resumable_stop (:269), and its test at :948 refers to the scope_guard constant. producer.rs:202-209 closes a non-success producer stop as 'the producer did not complete: <detail>'. output_from_result (claude.rs:249) writes that detail as '<subtype>: <first 300 chars>'. StreamState is Default, its `result` field is public, and on_line (stream.rs:77) calls parse_result. athena-agent is a normal dependency of athena-core. status.rs:1759 calls list_lines with `records` already loaded at :1637. line_pause (:728) returns the stored file with no recompute, and try_watch_line takes the forecast from line.last() (:771-772). The plan names the root cause where it starts: two lists of environment reasons that disagree, read from free text. It replaces them with one classifier used by the guard, by resume and by the producer's write path. The 401 and 429 rule is narrow: only the CLI's 'API Error: NNN' form under subtype success or error, with no loose words, and it is gated on Closed(Failed) so timed-out jobs still count as work. The pause is recomputed on read and never created there. It uses the forecast in force when the pause was written, which answers the earlier T3 finding, and it is tested at the go and retry call sites. Each demonstration drives production entry points, and builds the stored detail through the real parser and formatter. Each would fail without the change. I found no blocker, no major issue and no soundness problem; the three findings are small notes.
